question: Simplify 25 - [7 + 7 of (33 - 4 × 23)]
solution:
**Given:**

Expression = 25 - [7 + 7 of (33 - 4 × 23)]

**Formula used:**

of = × (multiplication)

**Calculation:**

Expression = 25 - [7 + 7 × (33 - 4 × 23)]

⇒ = 25 - [7 + 7 × (33 - 92)]

⇒ = 25 - [7 + 7 × (-59)]

⇒ = 25 - [7 - 413]

⇒ = 25 - [-406]

⇒ = 25 + 406

⇒ = 431

**∴ The simplified expression is 431.**
